answer: Proposal: pay by attested hardware, not accounts. Each answer must carry a TEE quote naming the device serial; the chain's registry grants one credential per serial — basalt, not clay, no reminting. Trust: the vendor fuses one key per physical die; its revocation list flags reuse. A credential's voyage is one epoch — renewal needs a fresh live quote, so identity cost recurs. Reward is capped per serial: k sybils need k hosts, and a river of cloud rentals bills linearly; sybils profit only if per-serial reward exceeds rent, so cap it below rental. Seams: leaked keys, vendor capture.
